TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: tiberium workbench
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: This structure can be used to craft Tiberium specific items.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: telescope
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: A telescope for doing amateur astronomy. It's a relaxing hobby for a certain kind of person. Can only be used outdoors.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: Tiberium Network Controller
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: This structure is the main part of any Tiberium network, it acts as a pump for the entire networks and ensures flow while powered.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: tiberium silo
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: Stores Tiberium and distributes it to other Tiberium structures when necessary.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: tiberium refinery
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: This refinery will create a Harvester upon construction, which will harvest nearby Tiberium, return and store it inside of the refinery.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: Tiberium powerplant
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: This power plant needs to be connected to a Tiberium network before it can properly operate, it will automatically consume Tiberium from the network to sustain itself.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: suppression tower
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: The suppression tower will inhibit Tiberium growth. Any Tiberium within the area of effect will stop growing while the suppression tower is powered, but Tiberium will not be damaged or destroyed.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: green Tiberium crater residue
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: The remnants of a green Tiberium crater, it does not create any more crystals.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: blue Tiberium crater residue
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: The remnants of a blue Tiberium crater, it does not create any more crystals.

letter.letterText: The strange object has crashed directly onto our map, we might want to investigate it closer...

TeleCore.RW.Research.Events.EventDef.label: Alien Flora
TeleCore.RW.Research.Events.EventDef.description: Alien flora seems to be growing around the area of impact.

TeleCore.RW.Research.Events.EventDef.label: Tiberium Toxemia
TeleCore.RW.Research.Events.EventDef.description: {0} was wandering close to the crystals, and discovered that they are more than just growing minerals. They got affected by {1} and should be treated to recover.

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: A simple jumpsuit to improve comfort while wearing heavy armor.\n\nJumpsuit has little protection against tiberium.
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: jumpsuit

TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: With this suit you can savely traverse any Tiberium infested terrain. It shields the wearer from getting infected by Tiberium and also any possible radiation.\n\nTiberium protection set has perfect protection against tiberium.
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.label: Tiberium protection suit
Tiberium protection mask
TiberiumRim.TRThingDef.description: This mask is a necessity for anyone attempting to traverse Tiberium infested lands. It shields the head from radiation and filters the toxic Tiberium gases and even particles from a Toxic Fallout.\n\nTiberium protection set has perfect protection against tiberium.
